notes.title: New mode and minor fixes
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are happy to inform you that today we have released a new major update with reworked economy and difficulty progression, rebalanced weapons and a new game mode “Infinite”!
Also completely eliminated all the problems with the network part and significantly improved game optimization with large numbers of zombies.

Economy rework and difficulty progression:
It became easier to earn currency in the early stages of the game
Significantly increased the starting stock of currency for buildings at the beginning of the level
The chance of getting more currency in roulette has been increased

Weapon rebalance:
Increasing the power of a weapon depending on its cost is now less noticeable
Changed % of skills for different weapons - % increased for weapon types that were previously less popular with players
Slightly reduced the spread of shotguns
Reduced the spread of machine guns
Increased velocity of submachine guns
Slightly reduced damage and accuracy of rifles

New game mode “Infinite”
For survivors who want to test their mettle, we're introducing a new game mode where waves of enemies will appear endlessly!
You will be able to gain currency with each wave to strengthen your defenses.
Every few waves you will meet a boss, and after a certain number of successfully completed stages there can be several of them!
The number of opponents and their characteristics are constantly growing, and each new session takes place on a different map! This will challenge even the most experienced players.
And of course, the further you go - the more you earn! This is a great opportunity to replenish your arsenal and pump up your skills.

On behalf of our team, we would like to thank you for all the support you have given to our project in the past year. We are very grateful to you, and we plan to continue developing the project. Have a great holiday season and all the best in the coming new year!

notes.title: Preparing for global update and bug fixes
notes.content:
Dear friends,
We hasten to inform you that we are actively working on the project. A major update with the addition of infinite mode is waiting for you in the near future!
In the meantime, we have released a patch with bug fixes and bug fixes, in which we have fixed the following:
Fixed a bug when trying to connect to a random lobby
Fixed a bug that caused infinite loading when exiting a level
Fixed a bug when trying to connect to a friend through the Join button in the profile
Fixed an issue when trying to connect to a friend through the Friends panel interface
Fixed an error when trying to invite a friend by pressing the + button in the main menu 
Fixed an error when trying to invite a friend through the Friends panel interface
Fixed a bug where other players' skins were not displayed in the main menu
Fixed a bug that allowed you to buy weapons even if you didn't have enough money for them
Fixed a bug where the visual effect of a flamethrower remains when it is destroyed
Fixed a bug where not all buildings were destroyed during a boss battle
Fixed incorrect deceleration characteristics of some buildings
Fixed a bug where the Join Random Room button became inactive
Fixed visual display of destruction effects
